summary: Police reported that the Ministry's official website had been targeted by external parties.
confirmed_details: Police statement, as reported: the CID opened an inquiry; Sri Lanka CERT and ICTA took steps to restore the website; irregularities were noticed in how the state emblem was displayed; the Ministry began an internal inquiry.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: The exact date, method and extent of access were not stated in the reports read. One outlet's headline refers to repeated breaches; this was not confirmed in the text read.
investigation_status: CID inquiry and ministry-level inquiry reported open in January 2026. No outcome found.
remediation: Website restored and its security reinforced by Sri Lanka CERT and ICTA, as reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Does not indicate the site's present state.

summary: The Department's website was hacked and its content altered.
confirmed_details: Sri Lanka CERT confirmed the incident and investigated. CERT said on 2 January 2025 that the site had been restored. CERT officials later told the Sunday Times that their audit of the old website found serious weaknesses and that they recommended building a new site instead of restoring it.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: Reports differ on the date (night of 30 December or 31 December 2024). The site was reported as still under construction, without search, on 2 March 2025; the date of full restoration was not found.
investigation_status: Government announced investigations on 31 December 2024. No published outcome found.
remediation: Old website withdrawn; documents re-published on an interim site; a replacement site was planned, as reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: The reported audit findings concern the old website. They say nothing about the current one.

summary: The Ministry's website homepage was defaced.
confirmed_details: The Sri Lanka Air Force Cyber Security Centre said the websites of the Ministry and of the Foreign Employment Bureau were attacked and their homepages defaced.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: Attribution was not established in the report read.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: More than six years old. The ministry's name and site have changed since.

summary: A cyberattack on the Ministry's website was acknowledged after data said to come from it was offered for sale online.
confirmed_details: The Minister said a complaint was lodged with the CID about an apparent cyberattack on the official website, that Sri Lanka CERT opened a separate inquiry, and that no highly sensitive data was compromised.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: A listing dated 17 April 2026 on an underground forum claimed to offer data from the site. Press reports say it included officers' names, email addresses and contact numbers. The content and origin of the data have not been independently confirmed.
investigation_status: CID and Sri Lanka CERT inquiries reported open in April 2026. No outcome found.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: The incident is confirmed by the Minister; the description of the data is alleged.

summary: Files attached to regulatory applications were deleted from the Authority's document system hosted on the Lanka Government Cloud.
confirmed_details: The loss was discovered on 9 July 2021. The CID investigated with university assistance. Police said on 28 September 2021 that an engineer of the contracted IT vendor was arrested. No backup of the deleted files was available, as reported.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: Motive and responsibility were disputed in court and in the press. The outcome of the prosecution and the extent of data recovery were not found.
investigation_status: CID investigation and court proceedings reported in 2021. Final outcome not found.
remediation: Recovery efforts were reported from October 2021. Result not found.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: An insider or contractor data-deletion and backup failure in a back-end system. It was not an attack on the public website.

summary: The Department warned of fake websites imitating its online visa site.
confirmed_details: The Department said it had received reports of people paying fake websites and advised applicants to reach the visa site through the link on immigration.gov.lk.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Fraud by third parties. Not a compromise of any government system.

summary: A traveller publicly alleged exposure of personal data connected with the visa issuance system then in use.
confirmed_details: The Secretary to the Ministry of Public Security said the Ministry was concerned and had asked the Department to look into it, as reported by Daily Mirror.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: The existence, cause and scope of any exposure were not confirmed in the report read. The article's exact date was not captured.
investigation_status: Department asked to look into the matter. No published finding found.
label: POTENTIAL RISK - NOT VERIFIED
notes: Concerns an outsourced visa system, not immigration.gov.lk. Out of scope.

summary: An IT engineer told the Sunday Times that the ETA visa status page lacked sufficient verification before showing application details.
confirmed_details: The claim was published by the Sunday Times.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: The claim has not been confirmed by the Department or Sri Lanka CERT in any source read. No detail is recorded here and none was tested.
label: POTENTIAL RISK - NOT VERIFIED
notes: Concerns the ETA application, which is out of scope. NOT TESTED and not to be tested without written authorization.

summary: The Department announced a system problem that stopped ETA approval notices being issued.
confirmed_details: The Department published a notice to applicants on 18 February 2026.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: No cause was stated. Nothing links the outage to a cyber incident.
label: NO PUBLIC EVIDENCE AVAILABLE
notes: Recorded only to show that no cyber cause is evidenced. Out-of-scope system.

summary: A disruption of the Lanka Government Cloud interrupted online services of more than 30 government institutions for over a week.
confirmed_details: ICTA announced the disruption on 13 October 2025 and its full resolution on 21 October 2025, and said data security and integrity were not compromised. The Department of Motor Traffic said its own operations were not interrupted; a provincial revenue-licence system was among those affected.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: ICTA described a technical and capacity problem. Press speculation about a possible breach was not supported by any official statement read.
remediation: Services restored; cloud expansion under way, as reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: An availability incident. No public evidence of a cyber cause.

summary: Railway authorities said the official website was hit by a cyberattack that affected its train timetable section.
confirmed_details: Officials said the impact was limited to the timetable section, which was disabled as a precaution. The Department announced on 15 June 2026 that the website was back online. The Minister of Transport said the newly launched site was attacked within hours of launch.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: The nature of the attack was not stated in the reports read. One report says the timetable section was still offline on 15 June.
remediation: Affected section disabled, then site restored, as reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Does not indicate the site's present state.

summary: Sri Lanka Railways warned of fraudulent websites posing as its ticket-booking platform.
confirmed_details: Sri Lankan diplomatic missions published the Department's notice advising visitors to use only the official reservation site.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: The notice's original date was not captured.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Fraud by third parties. Not a compromise of any government system.

summary: A ransomware attack on the government cloud caused loss of email data for offices using gov.lk email addresses.
confirmed_details: ICTA confirmed that about 5,000 gov.lk email addresses were affected and that data from 17 May to 26 August 2023 was lost because no backup existed for that period. The CID opened an investigation.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: Which of the ten institutions lost data is not stated in any source read.
investigation_status: CID investigation reported in September 2023. Outcome not found.
remediation: Recovery efforts by ICTA and Sri Lanka CERT reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Affected email, not websites. Not attributed here to any single institution.

summary: Sri Lanka CERT was reported to warn of telephone callers impersonating Department officials.
confirmed_details: Hiru News reported the warning and that the Department does not send payment links to taxpayers.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: CERT's own notice was not located.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Fraud by third parties. See IRD-PUB-17 in the IRD public evidence review.

institution: Sri Lanka Police (agency under the Ministry)
summary: Official social media accounts of the Sri Lanka Police, including its YouTube channel, were taken over.
confirmed_details: The Police spokesman confirmed the takeover and later said the Police website itself was not compromised.
alleged_or_unconfirmed_details: Attribution to foreign actors was stated by police as a suspicion.
investigation_status: Police and Sri Lanka CERT inquiries reported. Outcome not found.
remediation: Accounts recovered, the YouTube channel last, as reported.
label: CONFIRMED HISTORICAL INCIDENT
notes: Concerns a separate agency and third-party platforms, not pubsec.gov.lk.

summary: No report of a compromise of the Department's website or tax system was found.
label: NO PUBLIC EVIDENCE AVAILABLE
notes: A search miss is not proof that no incident occurred.

summary: No report of a cyber incident affecting the Department's website was found. Reported system failures were attributed to technical causes.
label: NO PUBLIC EVIDENCE AVAILABLE
notes: A search miss is not proof that no incident occurred.

summary: No report of a cyber incident affecting the Center's website was found.
label: NO PUBLIC EVIDENCE AVAILABLE
